state: The mathematical research project already has several open roadmap items. A separate advisory-verifier hardening PR is waiting for rereview, so one independent bounded workstream can be started in parallel. Current relevant public project state: issue #27 is an active P1 second semantic-mutation fixture on CDCLean; issue #33 is an active hosted Lean/mathlib calculator whose remaining acceptance item is CDCLean reuse; issue #13 is a P1 Suzuki v3 compact-uniform arithmetic-limit audit with the source domain already refined to the upper half-plane but normalization/lambda control still open; issue #18 is a P1 proposed first non-RH smaller-problem mining pass over accepted formal corpora using Repository Search; issue #9 has merged source-consuming Wolfram witnesses and graph/cell validation, while strict backend JSON and observed-vs-expected validation remain open. The next workstream should reuse existing infrastructure, stay bounded, produce falsifiable evidence, and avoid opening an unrelated new research front.
question: Which single roadmap workstream should be launched next in parallel?

options.description: Reuse the now-calibrated hosted Lean calculator on the already-frozen CDCLean #27 fixture, satisfying the remaining #33 acceptance item and producing the next semantic-mutation execution evidence.
Continue the #13/#32 Suzuki v3 mathematical seam: test upper-half-plane convergence sufficiency and normalization/lambda control without importing an RH-equivalent assumption.
Start #18: mine accepted formal corpora for a first non-RH bounded smaller problem using Repository Search dependency evidence before spending literature effort.
Continue #9/B: add strict backend JSON and independently validate observed Wolfram values against expected results instead of trusting payload.pass.
